title: Agent catalog baseline v1
description: The versioned list of the catalog's agent identifiers with group, domain, display name, and permitted-tool baseline, and the platform tool allowlist, as fixed by docs/architecture/intelligence-agent-catalog.md (Specialist Agent Catalog, Coach Agent Catalog, MCP Tool Policy). The baseline changes only with the architecture: it is read through GET /api/v1/agent-catalog/baseline and is never registered or changed through the platform. Tool identifiers are written without parentheses.

version.description: Version of the catalog baseline (SemVer 2.0.0 without build metadata).

toolAllowlist.description: Every tool identifier that a tool policy may grant.

agents.description: The nine catalog agents: three Coach Agents and six Specialist Agents.

toolId.description: A tool identifier of the platform tool allowlist, written without ().

permittedTools.description: The permitted-tool baseline of the agent; a tool policy may grant at most these tools.
